name: Junjou Idol Dosukebe Produce ~Hoshizora Yuzu no Tanezuke Sakunyuu Keikakusho~
original_name: 純情アイドル どすけべプロデュース～星空ゆずの種付け搾乳計画書～
source:
It began with an invitation on idol Yuzu Hoshizora's blog.

"I'm looking for an indie producer to team up with for my next project!"

I emailed my ideas to her, but realized too late I had also sent a ton of erotic fanfiction and porn sketches.
Oh god oh god oh god, my life is over...

The next day Yuzu came to my house.
"Thank you so much for this! Please... I want you to produce all of these ideas... using me!" 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE123844.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一切始于偶像星空柚子博客上的邀请。

“我正在寻找一位独立制作人来合作我的下一个项目！”

我通过电子邮件将我的想法发送给她，但意识到为时已晚，我还发送了大量的色情同人小说和色情草图。
天哪，天啊，天啊，我的生命结束了……

第二天，柚子来到我家。
“非常感谢你！拜托……我希望你能利用我来产生所有这些想法！”
